title: STL1267改变CoCl2处理HeLa细胞的HIF-1α与REV-ERB定位及转录响应
originalTitle: STL1267 alters HIF-1α and REV-ERBα localization and transcriptional responses in CoCl2-treated HeLa cells
summary: STL1267通过调节HIF-1α和REV-ERB的细胞定位，显著影响CoCl2处理的HeLa细胞基因表达谱，并激活ATF4介导的氨基酸代谢通路。实验显示STL1267使外核区REV-ERB染色增强，同时减少HIF-1α核区染色强度。

story.title: STL1267调控CoCl2处理下HeLa细胞HIF-1α/REV-ERB定位及基因表达

author: Makhija, S., Griffett, J. D., Griffett, K.
